outcome: mRNA expression of TNF-α and SOCS3 in VAT and SAT
Promoter methylation patterns of TNF-α and SOCS3
cohort: 41 pregnant women (19 with GDM and 22 with NGT)
finding: VAT inflammation, potentially driven by epigenetic changes in TNF-α and SOCS3 expression, may play a crucial role in GDM pathogenesis.
